snippet.title: Goblin Smasher Official Trailer | Hover to Smash Thousands of Goblins
snippet.description:
Hover over goblins and your hammer smashes them. Start with a handful in a quiet meadow, end with thousands on one screen.

▶ Play the Demo and Wishlist on Steam!

Goblin Smasher is a pixel art incremental game about one hammer and a great many goblins. You don't click. Move the mouse over the horde and Thumper, a grumpy war mallet who flattened the last Goblin King a hundred years ago, does the smashing for you. Every day pays, and every upgrade makes the next one bigger, louder and sillier.

What's inside:
• 8 goblin lands, each with its own warlord
• 10 legendary hammers forged at the Anvil
• 12 landmarks that take on the horde with you: minecart lines, quicksand, a war bell and more
• A War Tree with 91 nodes and nearly 700 upgrade levels
• Autosmash for idle days, or play every swing yourself
• An Endless Horde after the credits

📧 games@monadra.com

#GoblinSmasher #IndieGame #IncrementalGame
